description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the sizes of method pointers in classes with different inheritance types, including multiple and virtual inheritance, specifically on MSVC compilers. It also tests handling of method pointers for incomplete classes within the Abseil synchronization library.

classes.name: IncompleteClass
classes.description: Forward declaration of an incomplete class used for testing method pointer sizes.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: A class with a boolean member and a method that toggles it, used in inheritance tests.

classes.name: M2
classes.description: A class with a boolean member and a method that toggles it, used in inheritance tests.

classes.name: MultipleInheritance
classes.description: A class inheriting from Callback and M2, used to test multiple inheritance method pointers.

classes.name: VirtualInheritance
classes.description: A class with virtual inheritance from Callback, used to test virtual inheritance method pointers.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Toggles a boolean member and returns its new value; part of Callback and VirtualInheritance classes.

methods.name: method2
methods.description: Toggles a boolean member and returns its new value; part of M2 class.
